description: This source file contains C code related to an XMPP connection management plugin within a TR-069 device management context. It handles subscription to connection events, updates to Jabber IDs, and connection lifecycle events such as addition, deletion, and updates, specifically for XMPP connections.

methods.name: bool is_current_cnx(const char * cnx)
methods.description: Checks if the provided connection name matches the current XMPP connection stored in the management server configuration.

methods.name: void set_connreq_jabber_id(const char * jid)
methods.description: Sets the ConnReqJabberID attribute in the management server configuration via a transaction.

methods.name: void update_connreq_jabber_id(const char * cnx)
methods.description: Updates the Jabber ID used in connection requests based on the current connection state.

methods.name: void xmpp_connection_deleted_cb(UNUSED const char * const sig_name,const amxc_var_t * const data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Callback invoked when an XMPP connection is deleted; updates the management server configuration if necessary.

methods.name: void xmpp_connection_updated_cb(UNUSED const char * const sig_name,const amxc_var_t * const data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Callback invoked when an XMPP connection is updated; triggers a Jabber ID update.

methods.name: void xmpp_connection_add_sub(const char * cnx)
methods.description: Subscribes to notifications for a specific XMPP connection.

methods.name: void xmpp_connection_del_sub(const char * cnx)
methods.description: Unsubscribes from notifications for a specific XMPP connection.

methods.name: void _connreq_xmpp_connection_changed(UNUSED const char * const sig_name,const amxc_var_t * const data,UNUSED void * const priv)
methods.description: Handles changes to the XMPP connection request configuration by updating subscriptions and Jabber ID.

methods.name: void deferred_init_timer_cb(UNUSED amxp_timer_t * timer,UNUSED void * priv)
methods.description: Callback function for deferred initialization that sets up subscriptions and initial connection state.

methods.name: int cwmp_plugin_xmpp_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the XMPP plugin, setting up a timer that triggers deferred setup.
